eyeOd: OD = right eye (oculus dexter). Shown on the left, as when facing the patient.
eyeOs: OS = left eye (oculus sinister). Shown on the right, as when facing the patient.
normalEye: Fill {eye} with your normal findings (you can undo)
clearEye: Empty every box for {eye} (you can undo)
normalOu: Fill both eyes with your normal findings (you can undo)
copyOdToOs: Copy the right eye's findings to the left eye (you can undo)
copyOsToOd: Copy the left eye's findings to the right eye (you can undo)
codeHint: Shorthand codes: {codes}. In the shorthand bar ({keys}) type a code, a colon and the value.
allergyNotRecorded: Allergies are not recorded yet. Add them, or confirm there are none, in the history panel.
allergyListed: Allergies on file. Check before giving drops or medicines.
allergyNone: No known allergies, confirmed in the history panel.
signSaving: Saving. Sign is available as soon as everything is saved.
themeDim: Dim room: darker, lower-glare colours for an exam room with the lights down (Shift+D)
typeLocked: Save or cancel this entry first, then switch the history type.
dragHandle: Drag to reorder (or use the ↑ and ↓ buttons)
noCode: No diagnosis code yet: add one after the item is in the list.
motilityRemove: Remove mode: each tap takes one mark away
coverZone: {zone}: the cover test with this condition
vfQuad: {quadrant}, {eye}: tap for defect, again for full, again to clear
fullToCf: Full to CF: the patient counted fingers in every quadrant of both eyes.
dropGiven: {name}: tap to mark as given, tap again to undo. The first drop fills in the dilation time.
rxHiddenValues: This panel is hidden but has values
tourShorthand: Type findings here without leaving the keyboard, for example rc:1+ inj. Press Alt+K to jump here from anywhere.
tourKeys: Each exam section has a number key: press 1 to 0 to move between sections. Press ? for every shortcut.
tourQp: One-tap findings for the open section. Choose OD, OS or OU on each pick.
tourNormal: Normal fills an eye with your normal findings; OD → OS copies one eye to the other. Both can be undone.
tourSign: When the visit is done, Sign locks it. Later changes become addenda.
tourAgainDone: The tour will show on the next exam you open.
showTooltipsHelp: Explanations when you point at or tab to a control. Off: long-press still shows them, and screen readers still hear them.
hertelCode: Shorthand: HERT:15-100-16 = OD 15 mm, base 100 mm, OS 16 mm, typed in the shorthand bar ({keys}).
codeHintOpen: Click (or press Enter) to look them up in the shorthand help.
